name: BluOS players
description: Plays the station on a Bluesound, NAD or Dali player on this network.

configFields.label: Find players on the network
configFields.help: Asks for players with a broadcast on UDP port 11430, which is how BluOS itself finds them. Turn it off on a network that blocks broadcasts and list the players below instead.

configFields.label: Players
configFields.help: Addresses to use whether or not they were found, one per line. Port 11000 is assumed.

configFields.label: Caption on the player
configFields.help: Shown as the first line on the player's own display. It is set once when playback starts and then stays, so it should say something that is true all evening: the station's name rather than anything about a record.

configFields.label: Logo on the player
configFields.help: An absolute image address the player can reach, shown beside the caption. Set once with the caption, and left alone after that.
